tasks.label: ESP-IDF: Clean All Profile Build Directories
tasks.command: if (Test-Path build_dev) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build_dev }; if (Test-Path build_prod) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build_prod }; if (Test-Path build_ci) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force build_ci }; Get-ChildItem -Filter sdkconfig.* | Where-Object { $_.Name -notlike 'sdkconfig.defaults*' } | Remove-Item -Force
tasks.detail: Removes all profile build output directories (build_dev, build_prod, build_ci) and generated sdkconfig files.

tasks.label: Docs: Generate Full API Reference (Doxygen + Moxygen)
tasks.command: doxygen Doxyfile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -or $?) { moxygen --flavor github -a -o docs/api.md docs/doxygen/xml }
tasks.detail: Runs Doxygen to generate XML and converts it into docs/api.md using Moxygen.

tasks.label: Docs: Generate Multi-Page API Reference (docs/api/*.md)
tasks.command: doxygen Doxyfile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -or $?) { if (!(Test-Path docs/api)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path docs/api }; moxygen --flavor github -a -g -c -o docs/api/%s.md docs/doxygen/xml }
tasks.detail: Runs Doxygen and generates multi-page markdown files categorized by groups and classes.

tasks.label: Docs: Run Doxygen Only
tasks.detail: Builds Doxygen documentation (XML and HTML) into docs/doxygen/.

tasks.label: Docs: Run Moxygen Only (from existing XML)
Docs: Clean Generated Documentation
tasks.command: if (Test-Path docs/doxygen) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force docs/doxygen }; if (Test-Path docs/api.md) { Remove-Item -Force docs/api.md }; if (Test-Path docs/api) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force docs/api }
